constellations.desc: Alyosha regenerates 15 Elemental Energy when nearby party members trigger an <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro-related reaction</color> on an opponent. This effect can trigger once every 18s.
constellations.name: Frostvale Thunderclap

constellations.desc: The duration of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Advance</color> is extended by 6s.\nAdditionally, each time {LINK#N11480002}<color=#FFD780FF>Tugarin</color>{/LINK} attacks the opponent, he will also apply the {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Mark</color>{/LINK} to a target. This effect does not activate existing <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Marks</color>.
constellations.name: Howl From Afar

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Thunderbolt Strike</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Friendly Call

constellations.desc: When {LINK#N11480002}<color=#FFD780FF>Tugarin</color>{/LINK} attacks, he will also restore 60% of Alyosha's ATK as HP to the nearby party member with the lowest HP by percentage.
constellations.name: Harvest the Spoils

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Advance</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: When the Nightbird Falls Silent

constellations.desc: The <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Precision</color> effect obtained from activating a {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Mark</color>{/LINK} can now stack, max 2 stacks. When the stack count reaches 2, currently active party members will also have their Elemental Mastery increased by 100.
constellations.name: Standard Reclaimed

passives.desc: When {LINK#N11480002}<color=#FFD780FF>Tugarin</color>{/LINK} attacks, it will also restore HP to nearby active characters at 120% of Alyosha's ATK.
passives.name: Awakened by the Baying Hounds

passives.desc: Increases the DMG Alyosha deals with his Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst by 0.35% for every 1% of his Energy Recharge. Up to a 70% increase can be obtained in this way.
passives.name: Suffer the Winter Wheat Will

passives.desc: Alyosha will enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state when inside a {LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>{/LINK}.\n<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: The <color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Precision</color> effect obtained when the {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's Mark</color>{/LINK} is activated will also increase Stellar-Conduct DMG dealt by all currently active party members by 20%.
passives.name: Into the Fray

passives.desc: Displays the location of nearby <color=#FFD780FF>resources unique to Snezhnaya</color> on the mini-map.
passives.name: Treetop Watch

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes and applies the {LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>Hunter's {LINK#N11480001}{/LINK}Mark</color>{/LINK} to the opponent hit by the final strike.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents in his path.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
skills.name: Skirmishing Spear

skills.desc: Follows his hunter's instincts. Tap or hold to produce different effects as well as apply the {LINK#N11480001}Hunter's Mark{/LINK} effect to the hit opponents. Tapping Fires at opponents in front of him, dealing AoE Electro DMG. Holding Goes into aiming mode, then targets opponents within a certain area in front of him. Alyosha's Interruption RES is enhanced when in this mode. At the end of the button hold, he deals Electro DMG to the targeted opponents. The reckless hunter once reached for the spear's edge, and it was only after they survived a lesson paid in blood that they came to understand the harsh truths of survival on the frozen plains.
skills.name: Thunderbolt Strike

skills.desc: Summons his trusted companion Tugarin to fight alongside him on the field. This also turns an area in front of him into a Fulgurite Hunting Field for a short time. Fulgurite Hunting Field · Continuously taunts nearby opponents to incite them to attack. · Every 2s, deals an instance of AoE Electro DMG to any opponent that has wandered into the field. Tugarin · If there are any opponents nearby, Tugarin will quickly move close to an opponent and maul them every 2s, dealing Electro DMG. · If an opponent affected by the Hunter's Mark effect is hit, the Hunter's Mark will also be activated. · Where there are multiple opponents, Tugarin will attack those affected by the Hunter's Mark effect first. Wait. Keep waiting until the impatience fades. That's when the red-bellied plover shall sweep across the birch grove and present itself before one's arrow.
skills.name: Hunter's Advance

hyperlinks.name: Polestar Field

hyperlinks.description: A special effect Alyosha can apply on the opponent.\nWhen this effect is applied to an opponent who is already under the Hunter's Mark effect, it will activate Hunter's Mark instead, which removes said mark and grants all nearby party members the Hunter's Precision effect, increasing the ATK of currently active party members for 15s.
hyperlinks.name: Hunter's Mark

hyperlinks.description: Alyosha's trusted hunting hound and companion, which can be summoned to the field using the Elemental Burst Hunter's Advance.\nPeriodically moves close to an opponent to maul them, and activate any existing Hunter's Marks.
hyperlinks.name: Tugarin

info.description: A "professional hunter" and master of the Snezhnayan snowfields. A fierce, distinct "idealism" burns beneath his calm demeanor.
info.name: Alyosha
info.title: Swift-Striding Hound

const1.description: 队伍中附近的角色对敌人触发<color=#FFACFFFF>雷元素相关反应</color>后，将为阿罗夏恢复15点元素能量，该效果每18秒至多触发一次。
const1.name: 寒谷轰雷

const2.description: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>守猎进踞</color>的持续时间延长6秒。\n此外，{LINK#N11480002}<color=#FFD780FF>图加林</color>{/LINK}每次攻击敌人前，还会为一名目标施加{LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>弋猎印记</color>{/LINK}；该效果不会激活已有的<color=#FFD780FF>弋猎印记</color>。
const2.name: 长嗥远讯

const3.description: 元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>伏袭霆击</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
const3.name: 僚朋相唤

const4.description: {LINK#N11480002}<color=#FFD780FF>图加林</color>{/LINK}进行攻击时，还会为队伍中附近的生命值百分比最低的角色恢复生命值，回复量相当于阿罗夏攻击力的60%。
const4.name: 衔取猎品

const5.description: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>守猎进踞</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
const5.name: 莺啼止时

const6.description: 激活{LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>弋猎印记</color>{/LINK}时获得的<color=#FFD780FF>猎者之准</color>效果可以叠加。该效果至多叠加2层，叠加至2层时，还会使处于该效果影响下的当前场上角色的元素精通提升100点。
const6.name: 复夺旌幡

hyperlinks.description: 触发星超导反应时，附近的区域会短暂变化为极星辉域；处于极星辉域中时，特定角色将会进入辉映·星超导状态，使其不同技能分别获得对应的强化效果。
hyperlinks.name: 极星辉域

hyperlinks.description: 阿罗夏向敌人施加的特殊效果。\n对已经处于弋猎印记影响下的敌人再次施加该效果时，将会改为激活弋猎印记：移除该印记，并使队伍中附近的所有角色获得猎者之准效果：处于场上时，攻击力提升。
hyperlinks.name: 弋猎印记

hyperlinks.description: 深受阿罗夏信赖的猎犬伙伴，可以通过施放元素爆发守猎进踞召唤至场上，会间歇性快速移动至一名敌人附近，对其进行撕咬攻击，并激活已有的弋猎印记。
hyperlinks.name: 图加林

info.description: 纵横于至冬雪原的「职业猎手」。其冷静的外表下，似乎隐藏着别样炙热的「理想」。
info.name: 阿罗夏
info.title: 疾掠弋缇

p1.description: {LINK#N11480002}<color=#FFD780FF>图加林</color>{/LINK}进行攻击时，还会为队伍中附近的当前场上角色恢复生命值，回复量相当于阿罗夏攻击力的120%。
p1.name: 惊醒沉睡的林线

p2.description: 基于阿罗夏的元素充能效率，提升阿罗夏的元素战技与元素爆发造成的伤害：每1%元素充能效率都会使上述伤害提升0.35%，至多提升至70%。
p2.name: 告别冬麦与残叶

p3.description: 处于{LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>极星辉域</color>{/LINK}中时，阿罗夏将会进入<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星超导</color>状态。\n<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星超导</color>：激活{LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>弋猎印记</color>{/LINK}时获得的<color=#FFD780FF>猎者之准</color>效果还会使角色处于场上时造成的星超导反应伤害提升20%。
p3.name: 星赴险域

p4.description: 在小地图上显示周围的<color=#FFD780FF>至冬区域特产</color>的位置。
p4.name: 树梢察伺

elementalburst.description: 召唤信赖的好伙伴图加林一同战斗，并将前方区域短暂变换为轰霆猎场。 轰霆猎场 ·持续嘲讽周围的敌人，吸引敌人攻击； ·每隔2秒，对踏入其中的敌人造成一次雷元素范围伤害。 图加林 ·若周围存在敌人，每隔2秒，图加林将快速移动至一名敌人附近，对其进行撕咬攻击，造成雷元素伤害。 ·若命中的敌人处于弋猎印记效果影响下，还会激活弋猎印记。 ·图加林会优先攻击处于弋猎印记效果影响下的敌人。 等待，等待到不再心焦，便有赤腹兰鸻飞越白桦林，迎接他的射击。
elementalburst.name: 守猎进踞

elementalskill.description: 循借猎人的本能，依据点按、长按，以不同的方式产生效果，并对命中的敌人施加{LINK#N11480001}弋猎印记{/LINK}效果。 点按 向前方射击，造成雷元素范围伤害。 长按 进入瞄准状态，并选定前方一定范围内的敌人，在该状态下提高阿罗夏的抗打断能力。 长按结束时，对选定的敌人造成雷元素伤害。 莽撞的猎手曾向枪尖攀爬，随后，有幸熬过血的教训，领悟雪原的生存至理。
elementalskill.name: 伏袭霆击

normalattack.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>普通攻击</color>
进行至多四段的连续枪击，并对最后一击命中的敌人施加{LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>弋猎印记</color>{/LINK}效果。

<color=#FFD780FF>重击</color>
消耗一定体力，向前方突进，对路径上的敌人造成伤害。

<color=#FFD780FF>下落攻击</color>
从空中下坠冲击地面，攻击下落路径上的敌人，并在落地时造成范围伤害。
normalattack.name: 角枪驰弋

passives.name: 告别冬麦与残叶

passives.desc: 处于{LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>极星辉域</color>{/LINK}中时，阿罗夏将会进入<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星超导</color>状态。\n<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星超导</color>：激活{LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>弋猎印记</color>{/LINK}时获得的<color=#FFD780FF>猎者之准</color>效果还会使角色处于场上时造成的星超导反应伤害提升20%。
passives.name: 星赴险域

passives.desc: 在小地图上显示周围的<color=#FFD780FF>至冬区域特产</color>的位置。
passives.name: 树梢察伺

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>普通攻击</color>
进行至多四段的连续枪击，并对最后一击命中的敌人施加{LINK#N11480001}<color=#FFD780FF>弋猎印记</color>{/LINK}效果。

<color=#FFD780FF>重击</color>
消耗一定体力，向前方突进，对路径上的敌人造成伤害。

<color=#FFD780FF>下落攻击</color>
从空中下坠冲击地面，攻击下落路径上的敌人，并在落地时造成范围伤害。
skills.name: 角枪驰弋

skills.desc: 循借猎人的本能，依据点按、长按，以不同的方式产生效果，并对命中的敌人施加{LINK#N11480001}弋猎印记{/LINK}效果。 点按 向前方射击，造成雷元素范围伤害。 长按 进入瞄准状态，并选定前方一定范围内的敌人，在该状态下提高阿罗夏的抗打断能力。 长按结束时，对选定的敌人造成雷元素伤害。 莽撞的猎手曾向枪尖攀爬，随后，有幸熬过血的教训，领悟雪原的生存至理。
skills.name: 伏袭霆击

skills.desc: 召唤信赖的好伙伴图加林一同战斗，并将前方区域短暂变换为轰霆猎场。 轰霆猎场 ·持续嘲讽周围的敌人，吸引敌人攻击； ·每隔2秒，对踏入其中的敌人造成一次雷元素范围伤害。 图加林 ·若周围存在敌人，每隔2秒，图加林将快速移动至一名敌人附近，对其进行撕咬攻击，造成雷元素伤害。 ·若命中的敌人处于弋猎印记效果影响下，还会激活弋猎印记。 ·图加林会优先攻击处于弋猎印记效果影响下的敌人。 等待，等待到不再心焦，便有赤腹兰鸻飞越白桦林，迎接他的射击。
skills.name: 守猎进踞
